This is a variation of fruit cake that originated in Ireland. 

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Flour|cake flour]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|sultanas or golden raisins]]
*6 oz white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*6 oz [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*2 oz [[Cookbook:Zest|citrus peel]]
*2 oz [[Cookbook:Cherry|dried cherries]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|350°F]].
#[[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] together flour, salt and baking powder.
#[[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] together butter and sugar; this may take 5–10 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] in eggs individually, incorporating each fully before adding the next.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in fruits then the dry mixture.
#Transfer batter to a greased and [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined 8-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] on the center rack for 75–90 minutes. Check for doneness after 60 minutes.
#Let cake cool to room temperature in pan.
#Remove to a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire tray]], cover with towel, and allow to sit until completely cool.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*This particular version of the recipe does not include whiskey. If you were to add it, it would be added along with the butter and sugar. Approximately 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] should be used.
*This recipe uses raisins and cherries but apples, strawberries, or raspberries can be substituted.
